## Disposition file

<!-- d10e: auto-prune -->
<!-- Copier-vendored from the agentic-engineering-template — do NOT edit
     here; change it in the template and pull via `copier update`. The
     auto-prune marker above lets `disambiguate prune` remove this term
     from a repo that never links it. -->

A **disposition file** holds the answers to the findings of one review
that ran outside a chain of waybill orders: one entry per finding, with
its owner and its status. Inside a chain, the orders' results carry the
findings and their answers, and no disposition file is written.

_Avoid_: disposition, for the file
